objective: A frozen statistic, computed exactly. The quiet part of a space is a largest set of lines among which no removal creates at a gluing line; the creative part is the rest, and the native count is its number of connected pieces. Test on fresh families, with SAT genus as ground truth, whether the native count equals the genus and its pieces locate the atoms: single atoms of each kind at every position, pairs and triples of atoms on small plane glue at all relative positions (adjacent ones included), and every three-fold space up to 22 points, where atoms touch.
